dependencies.reason: Supplies Client interface, domain data models, options configuration, forge detection, error hierarchy, and shared transport foundation that this adapter implements.

tasks.title: Implement GitHub client constructor, transport, error handling, and factory wiring
steps: Write unit tests TS-02-1, TS-02-2, TS-02-21, TS-02-22, TS-02-24, property tests TS-02-4, TS-02-23, and factory integration test TS-02-3 in issuex/github_test.go; verify they fail.

In issuex/github.go, define the unexported githubClient struct implementing issuex.Client with fields baseURL, token, userAgent, httpClient, repo, sleep func(time.Duration), allowMergeCommit bool, allowSquashMerge bool, allowRebaseMerge bool.

Implement NewGitHub(o Options) (Client, error): trim trailing slashes from o.BaseURL or fallback to GITHUB_API_URL or https://api.github.com; resolve token from o.Token, GITHUB_TOKEN, or GH_TOKEN; set default 30s timeout client and userAgent 'agent-fox'; initialize sleep to time.Sleep.
Implement Authenticated() bool returning token != '', and Close() error closing idle connections via CloseIdleConnections() on httpClient.Transport if supported and returning nil.
Update issuex.NewWithOptions in issuex/factory.go so that when o.NoOp is false and forge type is ForgeTypeGitHub, it calls NewGitHub(o) instead of returning ErrUnsupportedForge.

Implement (*githubClient).do(ctx, method, path, reqBody, respTarget) with standard headers (Accept, X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28, User-Agent, Authorization Bearer, Content-Type). Enforce 8 MB bounded reading via io.LimitReader.
Implement GitHub error payload parsing formatting message plus errors array details into HTTPError, wrapping ErrNotFound on 404 and ErrConflict on 405/409.

Implement rate-limit backoff retry in do(): on 429 or 403 with X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0, compute backoff via RetryAfter(); if <= 120s invoke sleep and retry once; if > 120s or retry fails, wrap ErrRateLimited.
Run go test ./issuex/... -run 'TestGitHub_Client|TestGitHub_Constructor|TestGitHub_Factory|TestGitHub_Headers|TestGitHub_Transport' to confirm tests pass.

tasks.title: Implement repository metadata inspection and merge policy caching
steps: Write unit tests TS-02-5 and TS-02-6 in issuex/github_test.go covering GetRepository success with permissions, merge strategies, and authenticated vs unauthenticated 404 responses; verify they fail.
In issuex/github.go, implement GetRepository(ctx context.Context, repo Repo) (Repository, error) executing GET /repos/{owner}/{name}.
Populate Repository fields FullName, DefaultBranch, Private, Archived, and Permissions booleans (Push, Pull, Admin) from GitHub repository response JSON.
Cache repository merge strategy flags allow_merge_commit, allow_squash_merge, and allow_rebase_merge on githubClient for pull request merge method resolution.
If GET /repos/{owner}/{name} returns HTTP 404, wrap ErrNotFound in HTTPError. If unauthenticated, wrap with an explanatory hint indicating the repository may be private and require authentication.
Run go test ./issuex/... -run 'TestGitHub_GetRepository' to confirm tests pass.

tasks.title: Implement issue lifecycle, comment handling, and label operations
steps: Write unit tests TS-02-7, TS-02-8, TS-02-9, TS-02-10, TS-02-11, TS-02-12, TS-02-13, TS-02-14, and TS-02-15 in issuex/github_issues_test.go; verify they fail.
In issuex/github_issues.go, implement unauthenticated checks returning ErrNoToken for mutation operations: CreateIssue, UpdateIssue, CloseIssue, AddComment, AddLabels, RemoveLabel, and CreateLabel.
Implement CreateIssue(ctx, repo, req) executing POST /repos/{owner}/{name}/issues and returning Issue with IsPR set to false.

Implement ReadIssue(ctx, ref) executing GET /repos/{owner}/{name}/issues/{number}, setting Issue.IsPR true if pull_request key exists, and calling ListComments; if comment fetch fails, populate IssueThread.CommentsErr without failing ReadIssue. On unauthenticated 404, annotate error with private issue guidance.
Implement UpdateIssue(ctx, ref, req) executing PATCH /repos/{owner}/{name}/issues/{number} with specified fields and returning updated Issue.
Implement CloseIssue(ctx, ref, comment): if comment is non-empty, call AddComment first; then PATCH issue state to closed.

Implement ListIssues(ctx, repo, filter) paginating GET /repos/{owner}/{name}/issues with state, labels, assignee, sort, direction, per_page=100; exclude items with pull_request key, and set IssueList.Incomplete = true if limit is reached with more items available.
Implement AddComment(ctx, ref, body) executing POST /repos/{owner}/{name}/issues/{number}/comments and returning comment html_url.

Implement ListComments(ctx, ref) paginating GET /repos/{owner}/{name}/issues/{number}/comments?per_page=100 up to 5 pages (500 items cap), setting CommentList.Truncated to true if page 5 returns 100 items.
Implement AddLabels(ctx, ref, labels) executing POST /repos/{owner}/{name}/issues/{number}/labels (returning nil immediately when labels slice is empty).
Implement RemoveLabel(ctx, ref, label) executing DELETE /repos/{owner}/{name}/issues/{number}/labels/{label} with URL escaping, treating HTTP 404 as nil success.
Implement CreateLabel(ctx, repo, label) executing POST /repos/{owner}/{name}/labels stripping leading # from color, treating HTTP 422 already_exists as nil success.
Run go test ./issuex/... -run 'TestGitHub_Issue.*|TestGitHub_Comment.*|TestGitHub_Label.*' to confirm tests pass.

tasks.title: Implement pull request lifecycle, reviews, CI checks, and merge resolution
steps: Write unit tests TS-02-16, TS-02-17, TS-02-18, TS-02-19, and TS-02-20 in issuex/github_pr_test.go; verify they fail.
In issuex/github_pr.go, implement unauthenticated checks returning ErrNoToken for CreatePullRequest, ClosePullRequest, PostReviewComment, and MergePullRequest.
Implement CreatePullRequest(ctx, repo, req) executing POST /repos/{owner}/{name}/pulls with title, body, head, base, draft flag, returning PullRequest with Merged: false.

Implement ReadPullRequest(ctx, ref) executing GET /repos/{owner}/{name}/pulls/{number}, parsing head branch, base branch, head SHA, draft, merged status; on unauthenticated 404, annotate error with private repository guidance.
Implement ReadChangedFiles(ctx, ref) executing GET /repos/{owner}/{name}/pulls/{number}/files?per_page=100 and normalizing statuses to added, modified, or deleted.
Implement GetPRState(ctx, ref) executing GET /repos/{owner}/{name}/pulls/{number} mapping to PRState (state=merged when merged is true, closed when state is closed, open otherwise).
Implement ClosePullRequest(ctx, ref) executing PATCH /repos/{owner}/{name}/pulls/{number} with state closed.
Implement GetCIChecks(ctx, ref): retrieve head commit SHA via ReadPullRequest, execute GET /repos/{owner}/{name}/commits/{head_sha}/check-runs?per_page=100, and map to CheckRun structs.

Implement GetPRReviews(ctx, ref) executing GET /repos/{owner}/{name}/pulls/{number}/reviews?per_page=100 and normalizing review states to lowercase approved, changes_requested, commented, or dismissed.
Implement PostReviewComment(ctx, ref, body) executing POST /repos/{owner}/{name}/pulls/{number}/reviews with event COMMENT and body.

Implement MergePullRequest(ctx, ref, opts): map MergeMethod explicit options (merge, squash, rebase); if MergeMethodDefault, inspect repository merge policy (merge > squash > rebase) via GetRepository; execute PUT /repos/{owner}/{name}/pulls/{number}/merge; map HTTP 405 and 409 to ErrConflict; return MergeResult on HTTP 200.
Run go test ./issuex/... -run 'TestGitHub_PR.*|TestGitHub_Merge.*|TestGitHub_CI.*' to confirm tests pass.
